unit.why: Two homiletic teachings attributed to R. Pinhas of Korets: an exegesis of the Zimri/Shlumiel episode and the reason Passover is the time of judgment for grain, plus the compiler's note on Lamentations; neither tells an event happening to a Hasidic figure.
unit.boundary_note: The compiler's footnote (*) is cut off mid-sentence and continues into the next division. The OCR text contains an inserted non-text phrase ('I can't understand this word.') after 'ובתלק'.
